utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Ira — I’ll check what tools we’re still missing for the repair drive and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good—just send me the list when you know, and I’ll keep an eye out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m still sorting the details too, but thanks, Nell. If you’re free, I could use help with setup or collecting supplies.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still happening, just not fully locked in yet?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: What do you need most right now for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We could use a few more tool kits and some extra volunteers for Sunday at the community center. I’m putting the details together, and I can share the full list now.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, yeah — I think it was the gate and a couple of the lane markers, but I’m still fuzzy on the rest.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help—just tell me the plan for the repair drive and what time you need me there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll plan on Saturday morning at the community center on Maple.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll plan on Saturday morning at the community center on Maple too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep an eye on the repair drive locations and note any updates—just tell me where to check first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — start at the first repair drive location, and I’ll bring whatever tools you need. Just let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that—what does the repair drive need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — we still need a couple of wrenches, screwdrivers, and some sturdy gloves. I’ll keep track and let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Uli — mostly we just need a few more people to sort donations and a ride for the larger items. If you can help with one simple task, that would be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can sort donations for a bit. Tell me when and where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What do you need me to bring, and when should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Mina — just bring yourself and maybe any basic tools you’ve got, and come by Saturday morning if that works.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard about the repair drive, but I’m still catching up on the details. Is there anything you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Nell — could you point me to the first repair drive location to check? I’ll keep an eye on any updates.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I pitch in, could you remind me exactly which parts need repair on the drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s the driveway crack and the loose section by the gate that need fixing. Just tell me when you want me there, and I’ll help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s happening for sure—looks like folks are already lining up tools and donations. I’ll let you know if I hear anything else useful.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Tess — I’m glad I didn’t miss it. Let me know if there’s anything I can bring or help with.
